Uber's high-stakes robotaxi bet is officially ditching its human safety net. Nuro, Lucid, and Uber are starting fully driverless public road testing in the San Francisco Bay Area, with employee-only rides launching shortly after.

First announced in July 2025, this three-way alliance represents Uber's aggressive comeback in autonomous ride-hailing, after having abandoned its own troubled in-house efforts years ago. By pulling human safety operators from behind the wheel of Lucid Gravity SUVs, the companies say they are clearing a critical hurdle toward a public launch.
